headline: Procedure growth and margin gains drive a strong quarter
summary_short: Intuitive reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $2.89B, up 18.5% y/y, with diluted EPS of $2.29 (+26.5% y/y) as worldwide procedure volume grew about 16% and the da Vinci/Ion installed base expanded double digits.
summary_long: Revenue rose 4.4% q/q and 18.5% y/y to $2.89B, driven by ~16% combined da Vinci/Ion procedure growth (da Vinci +15%, Ion +36%), higher da Vinci leasing revenue, and a larger installed base (11,710 da Vinci systems, +12% y/y; 1,096 Ion systems, +21% y/y). GAAP operating income rose to $971.9M (+13.6% q/q, +30.7% y/y) despite higher share-based compensation. Net income was $818.1M ($2.29 diluted EPS), including a $28M net-of-tax IEEPA tariff-refund benefit ($0.08/share); non-GAAP net income was $1.00B ($2.80/share). Cash, equivalents and investments rose to $8.63B (+$0.65B q/q) after $0.38B of buybacks. FY2026 outlook: da Vinci procedure growth of 13.5-15.5%, non-GAAP gross margin 68.0-69.0% (includes ~1.0pt tariff drag), non-GAAP opex growth 11-13%.

drivers.explanation: Growth reflects ~16% combined da Vinci/Ion procedure growth (da Vinci +15%, Ion +36%), higher da Vinci system leasing revenue, and a larger installed base of da Vinci and Ion systems.
Cost of revenue included a one-time $35.9M benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds on prior-period costs, alongside higher volume-driven revenue.
Revenue growth outpaced higher share-based compensation expense ($213M vs $200M y/y) and overall operating expense growth.
Included a $28M net-of-tax IEEPA tariff-refund benefit ($0.08/share) and $17M of excess tax benefits tied to share-based compensation.
Diluted EPS grew faster than net income as diluted share count fell about 1.9% y/y on continued buybacks (0.9M shares repurchased for $0.38B this quarter).
FY2026 outlook: da Vinci procedure growth of 13.5%-15.5% (expects near midpoint), non-GAAP gross margin 68.0%-69.0% (includes ~1.0pt tariff impact), non-GAAP opex growth 11%-13%.
